articles.title: MCP SDK Starter Guides Leave Authorization Outside the HTTP Setup Path
articles.summary: A review of four Tier-1 Streamable HTTP starter paths found no copied example that enables authentication or scoped authorization. The SDKs offer protections and authorization tools, but builders must assemble them when moving beyond a local endpoint.

articles.title: Reckless review – this breathless thriller about siblings in a hit-and-run is a masterpiece
articles.summary: The Australian retooling of Neil Forsyth’s excellent Guilt sees a brother and sister deal with the aftermath of accidentally killing a stranger. It’s a fast-paced, impressive ride Just do what your elder sister tells you. That’s all there really is to leading an easy life. As a senior female sibling myself, this has always been my belief and now, as a viewer of Australian comedy-drama-caper-thriller Reckless, I can report it as absolute fact.
